claim: RE-NAA awarded its 3rd Michelin star at the Nordic Star Revelation ceremony in Helsinki in 2024, becoming only the second Norwegian restaurant to hold 3 stars.
quote: The 3rd star confirms that our restaurant is a reason to go to Norway and Stavanger. We are finally there.

claim: RE-NAA pricing, address, capacity, dietary policy and booking channels.
quote: NOK 4,500 per guest for A Taste of RE-NAA. Nordbøgata 8, N-4006 Stavanger. +47 51 55 11 11. Cannot accommodate vegan diets or those requiring freedom from milk protein, eggs, and citrus.

claim: Chef Sven Erik Renaa's background, RE-NAA's star progression (1st star 2016, 2nd 2020, 3rd 2024), 22-seat capacity, Eilert Smith Hotel location.
quote: Sven Erik Renaa... was named chef of the year twice and guided Norway's national culinary team to victory at the 2008 Olympics in Erfurt. RE-NAA received three Michelin stars in 2024, following their first star in 2016 (the first restaurant outside Oslo) and a second star in 2020.

claim: RE-NAA serves ~15+ courses; cured squid styled as tagliatelle is a signature; ground floor of Eilert Smith Hotel; reviewer scored 18/20.
quote: The cured squid is one of the restaurant's signature dishes, steamed briefly and cut into tagliatelle strips with seaweed, black garlic, and breadcrumbs... A deserved three stars.

claim: RE-NAA held 2 stars in 2022 and 2023, then 3 stars in 2024 and 2025; no other Stavanger restaurant has reached 2 stars in the recorded period.
Eilert Smith Hotel is a 12-room boutique hotel in a 1937 functionalist warehouse in Stavanger, restored by Signe Anne and Kristoffer Stensrud in 2019; RE-NAA operates on the ground floor.
quote: 12 room boutique hotel... functionalist warehouse originally designed in 1937 by local architect Eilert Smith. In 2019, owners Signe Anne and Kristoffer Stensrud transformed the historic building into a boutique hotel.

claim: Norway's Michelin-starred lineup: 3-star Maaemo (Oslo) and RE-NAA (Stavanger); 2-star Kontrast (Oslo); 1-star Stavanger trio: Hermetikken, Sabi Omakase, K2.
quote: Three-Star: Maaemo (Oslo), RE-NAA (Stavanger). Two-Star: Kontrast (Oslo). Stavanger one-stars: Hermetikken, Sabi Omakase, K2, RE-NAA.

claim: RE-NAA is highlighted as Norway's first restaurant outside Oslo to earn three stars; western Norway lineup includes 1-star Hermetikken (May 2024), Sabi Omakase, K2 in Stavanger.
quote: RE-NAA is highlighted as Norway's first restaurant outside Oslo to achieve three stars... Hermetikken (1 star, awarded May 2024).

claim: RE-NAA's signature dishes include oyster emulsion with radish, lumpfish roe in waffle, lamb tartare, arctic cod with broccoli sauce, lobster with cauliflower purée, and a panna cotta styled as a soft-boiled egg with buckthorn berry yolk; open kitchen, ~16 menu items.
quote: Dishes included: oyster emulsion with radish, lumpfish roe in waffle, lamb tartare, scallops, mussels, arctic cod with broccoli sauce, lobster with cauliflower purée, and skate with caviar. Innovative desserts featuring panna cotta styled as a soft-boiled egg with buckthorn berry yolk.
